quote: treatment of patients with advanced or metastatic breast cancer as a single agent
note: Breast cancer is a labeled indication.

quote: improve wakefulness in adult patients with excessive sleepiness associated with obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), narcolepsy, or shift work disorder (SWD)
note: Narcolepsy-associated sleepiness is managed; counts as disease management.

quote: chronic treatment of mild to moderate atopic dermatitis
note: Atopic dermatitis is a synonym of atopic eczema.

quote: prolong the time to recurrence of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (PSVT) associated with disabling symptoms
note: PSVT explicitly indicated.

quote: metastatic ovarian carcinoma
note: Stage IV ovarian cancer corresponds to the labeled metastatic ovarian carcinoma.

quote: treatment of elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with ocular hypertension or open-angle glaucoma
note: Ocular hypertension is a labeled indication.

quote: Impetigo contagiosa, superficial folliculitis, ecthyma, furunculosis, sycosis barbae
note: Furunculosis listed among primary skin infections.

quote: indicated for the treatment of obsessions and compulsions in patients with Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD)
note: OCD explicitly indicated.

quote: adjunctive therapy ... seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome
note: Seizures of LGS are labeled; counts as management of LGS.

quote: Adult patients with relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma (LBCL)
note: LBCL explicitly indicated.

quote: locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma (PPGL)
note: Paraganglioma explicitly indicated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL) and T-cell lymphoblastic lymphoma (T-LBL)
note: Label covers only relapsed T-ALL; 'leukemia' is a whole disease class.

quote: acute treatment of migraine with or without aura in adults
note: Migraine without aura explicitly covered.

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis
note: EMA indication for UC.

quote: treatment of Human Immunodeficiency Virus type 1 (HIV-1) infection
note: HIV-1 treatment and PrEP indicated (EMA).

quote: indicated for the treatment of glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis
note: Glucocorticoid-induced = corticosteroid-induced osteoporosis.

quote: airflow obstruction in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), including chronic bronchitis and/or emphysema
note: Chronic bronchitis named; bronchitis is a near parent.

quote: Temporary control of rapid ventricular rate in atrial fibrillation or atrial flutter
note: Rate control in AF is a labeled indication.

quote: Tadalafil Tablets are indicated for the treatment of erectile dysfunction (ED)
note: ED explicitly indicated.

quote: As therapy for anaphylactic reactions adjunctive to epinephrine and other standard measures
note: Adjunctive therapy of anaphylaxis is labeled.

quote: chlorthalidone tablets, USP are indicated in the management of hypertension
note: Hypertension explicitly indicated.

quote: Not for the treatment of type 1 diabetes mellitus or diabetic ketoacidosis
note: Label explicitly excludes DKA (also a contraindication).
Local/regional anesthesia only; aspiration pneumonitis not mentioned.

quote: indicated in the treatment of ocular hypertension and chronic open-angle glaucoma
note: Glaucoma (open-angle) indicated.

quote: severe diarrhea-predominant irritable bowel syndrome ... frequent bowel urgency or fecal incontinence
note: Drug treats IBS-D; fecal incontinence only appears as a severity-defining manifestation.

quote: EGATEN is indicated for the treatment of fascioliasis in patients 6 years of age and older
note: Fascioliasis explicitly indicated.

quote: Definite Atherosclerotic Disease* ... * Coronary heart disease or peripheral vascular disease
note: Indicated for hypercholesterolemia; CHD appears only as a risk category in the NCEP table.

quote: Dermatologic Diseases Pemphigus Severe erythema multiforme (Stevens-Johnson syndrome) Exfoliative dermatitis
note: Exfoliative dermatitis listed among indicated dermatologic diseases.

quote: indicated for the treatment of moderate to severe acute pain, including postoperative pain, in adults
note: Bone pain not named; read as a narrower acute pain type (low confidence).
Label covers type 2 diabetes; ketosis-prone diabetes not mentioned (only DKA risk/exclusion).

quote: not indicated for suppression of benign thyroid nodules and nontoxic diffuse goiter in iodine-sufficient patients
note: Goiter appears only in a limitation of use.

quote: reduction of elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
note: OPTN-related OAG is a subtype of indicated open-angle glaucoma.

quote: secondary (post-polycythemia vera or post-essential thrombocythemia) myelofibrosis (MF)
note: Indicated for myelofibrosis; ET is only the antecedent background.

quote: MI and stroke in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus with multiple risk factors for CHD
note: Diabetes is the population for CV risk reduction, not the target.

quote: treatment of tinea pedis, tinea cruris, and tinea corporis
note: Tinea cruris = dermatophytosis of groin.
Lupus/discoid lupus not mentioned in any lidocaine text.

quote: anogenital pruritus (vulvae, scroti, ani)
note: Pruritus ani explicitly listed.

quote: Temporarily relieves these symptoms due to hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies: runny nose sneezing itchy, watery eyes
note: Hay fever = allergic rhinitis; symptom relief is its management.

quote: Locally or regionally advanced squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck in combination with radiation therapy
note: SCCHN indicated.

quote: Allergic conjunctivitis Keratitis Allergic corneal marginal ulcers
note: Keratitis listed among ophthalmic indications.

quote: the treatment of patients with atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome (aHUS)
note: aHUS indicated (STEC-HUS excluded); HUS is a near parent.

quote: adjunctive treatment to levodopa/carbidopa in adult patients with Parkinson's disease (PD) experiencing "off" episodes
note: Adjunctive PD treatment.

quote: Diphtheria: Infections due to Corynebacterium diphtheriae , as an adjunct to antitoxin
note: Diphtheria explicitly indicated.
Back pain not mentioned; venlafaxine indicated for MDD/anxiety disorders.

quote: treatment of Acute Bacterial Exacerbation of Chronic Bronchitis (ABECB)
note: ABECB explicitly indicated.
